newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended lower but a 500 million Swiss franc offering for Eurofima, with a four percent coupon priced at 102.20, met favourable demand.
Lead Credit Suisse First Boston said the bond, which can be reopened, will serve to finance rolling stock for the borrower.

"It is not so easy at the moment for 10 years, but there was a chance for such offerings since Monday with demand surfacing for Triple A's," one trader said. Swiss institutional demand had lessened in recent months after 10-year yields fell below 4.00 percent. The bond, placed on the basis of less 1.80, yielded 3.95 percent, the trader said.
The offer was priced at 20 basis points over federal bonds.
EuroSwiss franc futures traded on LIFFE were down sharply on what one trader described as heavy volume selling.

The KOF economic research department at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, said it saw only minor increases in Swiss interest rates in 1997/1998. Swiss unemployment also fell slightly to 5.6 percent in March from 5.7 percent in February.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down four at 111.05
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down eight at 98.07.
